newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber stable in slow late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber stable in slow late trade.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Friday, with few enquiries heard, dealers said.
"There are some enquiries heard which could lead to some deals later today, but any deals are likely to be done at current price levels," one dealer in Medan said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November/December were at at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.50-55.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.50-54.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
